text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
With the Classic Triple Crown in view, her rivals-- 
Duramente's own year--cannot be ignored.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Chief among them, Satono Crown. At present she holds 
the highest evaluation of anyone in their generation.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
She and Duramente are roommates, and because they know 
each other so well, they recognize each other's worth.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black and Cheval Grand are both horsegirls 
worth watching too. They are certain 
to come into their own before long.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
And yet, even among rivals like these, 
Duramente's running was simply overwhelming.
